page.title: Models
page.subtitle: Choose what to install — Toskar recommends models that fit your hardware.
page.emptyDescription: The local catalog is empty. Try Browse all models to install from Hugging Face.
page.ready: {{model}} finished downloading and is ready to use.

target.label: Models for:
target.allHint: Installs can go to every paired computer. Recommendations still emphasize what fits well.

discover.recommendedHint: Curated picks that fit the selected computer — purpose first.
discover.noMatches: No curated models match this search.

tools.webSummary: Uses local tools · Can fetch the web
tools.webDetail: Can read files, use git, and run terminal commands after you approve them. A command such as curl can look something up on the web. There is no separate browser.
tools.blockedSummary: Uses local tools · Web blocked by this profile
tools.blockedDetail: This model can run terminal commands, but the current assistant profile turns the terminal off, so it cannot fetch web pages.
tools.chatDetail: Answers from the model itself. It cannot run a terminal command, so it cannot look anything up on the web.

support.embedding: Embedding model: helps search knowledge, does not chat
support.reranker: Reranker: orders search results, does not chat
support.classifier: Classifier: sorts requests, does not chat

small.note: Small and fast, but it can mix up facts and numbers, especially from your files and knowledge. For questions about your data, a larger model is more reliable.
small.installedOther: {{model}} is installed. Pick it, or Auto, in chat for those questions.

capability.noWeb: Live web access isn't available with the current configuration.
capability.noTools: {{model}} cannot use tools, so it cannot look that up. Switch to a tool-capable model such as one below.
capability.noLocalTools: {{model}} does not use local tools, so it cannot read files, run commands, or use git for you.

tightFit.label: Tight fit
tightFit.hint: Uses most of this computer's available memory and may be less stable.
tightFit.title: This model may be unstable on this computer
tightFit.body: {{model}} uses most of the memory available on this computer. It may run slowly, stop responding, or cause system instability under heavier workloads or larger context sizes.
tightFit.advice: Toskar recommends leaving more memory available for the operating system and graphics.

browse.title: Browse all models
browse.description: Search Hugging Face for models Toskar can run locally. Installs use the computer selected above.
browse.failed: Could not reach Hugging Face. Check your network and try again.

installedTab.empty: No installed models yet. Install from Discover, then they will appear here.

runningTab.empty: No models are loaded right now. Chat will start one automatically when you need it.

ratings.yourRatingLabel_one: Your rating of {{model}}: {{count}} star. Change it
ratings.yourRatingLabel_other: Your rating of {{model}}: {{count}} stars. Change it
ratings.title: Rate {{model}}
ratings.intro: How well does it work on this computer? Your rating is saved here.
ratings.languageQuestion: How well did it work for you in {{language}}?
ratings.share: Share this rating with the community
ratings.shareHint: Helps people with computers like yours choose a model. You can stop sharing at any time.
ratings.observeNothing: Nothing measured yet. Use the model for a while first.

sent.idValue: A random ID, so you can change or remove your rating; not made from your computer
sent.never: Never your prompts, chats, file names, computer name, user name, or network address. The service doesn’t store your IP address.

ratings.notShareable: This rating stays on this computer: {{reason}}

similar.backend: on computers with this much memory

ratings.chosenByCommunity: Chosen with ratings from computers like yours
ratings.limitedHint: Only a few people have rated this, so the score leans toward the average until more do.
ratings.observedHint_one: From {{formatted}} rating that shared how it runs
ratings.observedHint_other: From {{formatted}} ratings that shared how it runs

external.title: External server
external.description: An OpenAI-compatible server, such as OpenAI, vLLM, or Ollama elsewhere. Its models can be chosen for a chat; Auto never picks them.
